name: ui-ack
prompt: Short dry wooden UI button click, single soft tap on a small wooden panel, quick and quiet with no reverb.

name: slab-place
prompt: Heavy stone slab landing on stone with a low dull thud, short dusty impact tail, solid masonry weight.

name: perfect-chime
prompt: Stone slab thud immediately followed by three bright ascending glass chime tones, crystalline shimmer, rewarding and clean.

name: overhang-trim
prompt: Stone edge shearing off with a gritty scrape, small rock fragments crumbling and falling, brief rocky debris.

name: slab-miss
prompt: Stone block tumbling past a tower and clattering down rocks, fading hollow bounces into the distance.

name: stage-win
prompt: Triumphant ascending bell fanfare of five warm tones, brass and glass chimes rising together, gentle celebratory shimmer.

name: round-lose
prompt: Three slow descending muted marimba notes, soft wooden disappointed cadence, calm and low.

name: drop-undo
prompt: Quick airy reverse whoosh, a stone slab sliding smoothly back upward, soft swooping suction.

name: hint-ping
prompt: Delicate high glass ping, single soft bell tap with a gentle shimmering decay, subtle and bright.

name: count-tick
prompt: Short dry metronome tick, single wooden block knock, crisp and neutral countdown beat.

name: count-go
prompt: Bright wooden clave strike with an energetic rising snap, punchy start signal.

name: achievement-chime
prompt: Sparkling three-note celesta flourish, cheerful badge-unlock chime with light magical glitter.

name: ambience-skyline
prompt: Quiet night-time city rooftop ambience heard from high above: a soft continuous breeze moving between stone buildings, very distant muffled city hum, no traffic, no voices, calm and steady, smooth and loopable.

name: lesson-complete
prompt: Warm resolving three-note wooden xylophone phrase ending on a gentle glass chime, soft and encouraging, short and clean with a light shimmer tail.

name: pause-hush
prompt: Soft low muffled wooden tap followed by a brief gentle airy hush, like a small padded lid closing quietly, subtle and short.
